followthrough_limit: Old GSE24369 replication was allocated-hit follow-through, so False does not establish complete individual gene array replication or all public native context coverage.
publication_novelty: Our unpublished table is prior exposure/reusable evidence, not primary published prior art. A useful claim may use validated existing data, but must be distinct from five completed failed questions and consequential beyond clinical target names.
exposure_truth: Prior broad results and R8 values had historical campaign exposure. This current gate read only exact gene/allocated/headers and allowed design/source/decision fields, no new numeric RNA fields or matrices.
